title: Three ordered MLINE LTYPE XDATA entity references

scope.source: Runtime-generated DXF records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

proof.source: The generated physical LTYPE XDATA, typed imported values, three distinct source handles, captured entity roles, model-space owner bindings and exact entity identities agree. All three LINE targets are uniquely identified by handle and geometry.
proof.output: Across all four ASCII/binary source-output pairs, staged physical output preserves XDATA order and emits each soft pointer as the exact remapped handle for its corresponding model-space LINE. Fresh typed readback verifies the ordered values and entity identity/owner joins.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the third target refuses output atomically and preserves the destination; restoring it by a saved list position succeeds on the same adapter. A late mutation of the third target handle also refuses atomically; restoring the source handle succeeds on the same adapter. The test does not retain an invalidated iterator across list erasure.

limits: This qualifies one three-reference AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA composition with one APPID, one string and three handles to model-space LINEs. Four-or-more references, other target types/sections, XDATA compositions, APPID metadata, schemas and versions remain unqualified.

The receipt proves selected transport, identity remapping, atomic refusal and retry only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, native MLINE rendering, recursive document closure or broader LTYPE support.
next: Select the next source-backed MLINE geometry/schema witness. Keep four-or-more LTYPE XDATA entity references and other target roles as separate unqualified boundaries; do not infer general XDATA or native semantics from this selected transport profile.
